description:
Reconcile historical reset-module documentation and current developer image guidance after SCR SDLC migration. Add clear current-versus-historical index linking root RELEASE.md, contracts/, evidence/feasibility/, evidence/revision-*, retained legacy REQ, dirty legacy workspace evidence, and active ITM-0001. Root RELEASE.md stops at revision 6/no DEB; later legacy workspace contains production source and package work. Old contracts still prescribe SRC/reset reasons superseded by observable-boot scope. Preserve original historical bytes, hashes, and provenance through managed artifact relocation and additive supersession/index records. Update docs/DEVELOPER-GUIDE.md procedures to current lock-held disposable-image rules; remove guidance that can imply original raw-image mutation and include current Codex entry points while retaining supported Claude tooling. Inventory tracked .codex/REQ-0001-revision-15-solution-plan.tmp.md and .codex/task-plan-rev15/ as historical artifacts; identify exact duplicates and retain unique material through explicit archive/index before any removal from active-looking paths. Acceptance: current module scope, actual acceptance limits, pending plan, safe image procedures, and authoritative locations are unambiguous; historical evidence remains intact and linked. No approval of ITM-0001, legacy resumption, hardware access, image mutation, or quarantine change.

Migration-chain ownership: depend on ITM-0004 actual retained command/safety interfaces and use ITM-0005 evidence/disposition references. Own independently useful historical index and current developer guidance; every link must resolve at this item's completion. Use stable archive/provenance entry points so later ITM-0006 can publish its final manifest without breaking this index. ITM-0006 owns final workspace archive, canonical module source handoff, compiler prerequisite fix, and readiness evidence; do not split this item's promised documentation acceptance into that later item. Document offline rebuild readiness separately from pending hardware/image acceptance. Do not rewrite hashed historical contracts or claim migration completion before later readiness verification.

Latest artifact-ownership ruling: All these folders belong to the planning, implementation and QA stage and should be managed under .codex/sdlc as in Specz (with claude). ITM-0002 owns tested managed-artifact tooling and complete relocation of root contracts/ and evidence/, including all hidden historical snapshots and current reports, with durable ledger bundles, exact byte/hash preservation, original-path mapping, and independent restore proof. This item consumes those verified managed collection/bundle locators and owns the complete useful historical/current index plus developer guidance. Prior canonical root-path retention is superseded; preserve historical payload bytes and old-path provenance, not obsolete root placement. Every live link must resolve through managed materialization or explicit recovery instructions. Do not re-import or rewrite hashed historical payloads. Publish this item's planning/implementation/QA deliverables under the managed .codex/sdlc artifact namespace through LETS. Existing image/hardware limits and documentation acceptance remain intact.
